text:
A drummer hits a drum harder to make a louder sound without changing the pitch of the sound.
Which statement describes the change in properties of the sound as the drummer hits the drum
harder?
A
Only the amplitude of the sound increases.
B
Only the frequency of the sound decreases.
C
Both the amplitude and the frequency of the sound increase.
D
Both the amplitude and the frequency of the sound decrease.

options.label: A
options.text: Only the amplitude of the sound increases.

options.label: B
options.text: Only the frequency of the sound decreases.

options.label: C
options.text: Both the amplitude and the frequency of the sound increase.

options.label: D
options.text: Both the amplitude and the frequency of the sound decrease.
